headline: Ghar ka khana, fast aur tasty – bina ghanton kitchen mein bitaye
bio: Hey, main hoon Ananya! Main working professionals aur beginners ko simple Indian veg cooking sikhati hoon taaki aap roz fresh aur yummy khana bana sako.

products.title: 15-Minute Veg Dinner Recipes Ebook
products.tierReason: A quick PDF guide works best as an accessible first purchase for new buyers.
products.summary: Roz raat ke liye 15-minute quick veg recipes
products.description: Working late? Yeh PDF guide aapko degi quick, healthy aur tasty veg recipes jo bas 15 minute mein ban jaati hain. Minimal ingredients aur zero stress.
whatYouGet: PDF ebook with 15 quick dinner recipes

products.title: Weekly Veg Meal Prep Template Pack
products.tierReason: A comprehensive planner pack that offers high utility for busy professionals.
products.summary: Office days ke liye complete meal planning templates
products.description: Busy weeknights par cooking easy banao. In readymade planners aur trackers se aapka poora week pehle se organize ho jayega bina kisi hassle ke.

products.title: Master Everyday Cooking Live Workshop
products.tierReason: Includes live interaction and real-time guidance from the creator.
products.summary: 2-hour live session for effortless everyday cooking
products.description: Mere saath live cooking seekho! Iss 2-hour Zoom workshop mein main aapko batayungi fast Indian cooking hacks, spices ka sahi use aur quick gravies.
whatYouGet: Live Q&A to ask your cooking doubts
